description_en: Retrieves the details of a KMS instance
name: GetKmsInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the KMS instance to query
parameters.name: kms_instance_id

schema.description_en: The details of the KMS instance

KmsInstance.description_en: The details of the KMS instance

BindVpc.description_en:
A list of associated VPCs.

You can associate the KMS instance with additional VPCs in the same region, allowing self-managed applications in those VPCs to access the instance. These VPCs can belong to the same or different Alibaba Cloud accounts
BindVpc.description_zh:
配置的VPC列表。
如果您的自建应用部署在同地域的多个VPC中，除了KMS实例所属的VPC（即启用KMS实例时设置的VPC）外，您还可以将其他VPC配置到KMS实例中，这些VPC可以属于同一个阿里云账号，也可以属于不同阿里云账号。配置完成后，在这些VPC中的自建应用即可以访问指定的KMS实例

items.description_en:
Details of an associated VPC.

You can associate the KMS instance with additional VPCs in the same region, allowing self-managed applications in those VPCs to access the instance. These VPCs can belong to the same or different Alibaba Cloud accounts
items.description_zh:
配置的VPC列表。
如果您的自建应用部署在同地域的多个VPC中，除了KMS实例绑定的VPC，您还可以将其他VPC配置到KMS实例中，这些VPC可以属于同一个阿里云账号，也可以属于不同阿里云账号。配置完成后，在这些VPC中的自建应用即可以访问指定的KMS实例

RegionId.description_en: The region where the VPC is located

VpcOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account to which the VPC belongs

CaCertificateChainPem.description_en: The CA certificate chain for the KMS instance in PEM format

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

`PREPAY`: subscription

`POSTPAY`: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：
PREPAY：预付费，包年包月。
POSTPAY：后付费，按量付费

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the KMS instance

EndDate.description_en: The expiration time of the KMS instance

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the KMS instance

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the KMS instance

KeyNum.description_en: The maximum number of keys that can be created in the KMS instance
KeyNum.description_zh: KMS实例支持创建的密钥数量

Log.description_en: Indicates whether logging is enabled for the KMS instance. Valid values: `1` (enabled) and `0` (disabled)
Log.description_zh:
KMS实例是否开启日志，取值：
0：不开启
1：开启

LogStorage.description_en: The log storage capacity. Unit: GB
LogStorage.description_zh: 表示日志的容量。单位为GB

ProductType.description_en:
The product type.
Subscription:
`kms_ddi_public_cn`: China site
`kms_ddi_public_intl`: international site
Pay-as-you-go:
`kms_ppi_public_cn`: China site
`kms_ppi_public_intl`: international site
ProductType.description_zh:
产品类型。 预付费：
kms_ddi_public_cn：中国站
kms_ddi_public_intl：国际站
后付费：
kms_ppi_public_cn：中国站
kms_ppi_public_intl：国际站

ProductVersion.description_en: The version of the KMS instance

SaleStatus.description_en: The sales status of the instance

SecretNum.description_en: The maximum number of credentials that can be created in the KMS instance
SecretNum.description_zh: KMS实例支持创建的凭据数量

Spec.description_en: The computing performance of the KMS instance

StartDate.description_en: The time when the KMS instance was enabled

Status.description_en:
The status of the KMS instance. Valid values:

`Uninitialized`: The instance is not enabled.

`Connecting`: The instance is connecting.

`Connected`: The instance is enabled.

`Disconnected`: The instance is disconnected.

`Error`: The instance is in an error state
Status.description_zh:
KMS实例的状态。取值：

Uninitialized：未启用
Connecting：连接中
Connected：已启用
Disconnected：已断开
Error：状态异常

VpcId.description_en: The VPC to which the KMS instance is attached

VpcNum.description_en: The maximum number of VPCs that can be associated with the KMS instance for access control

VswitchIds.description_en: The vSwitches in the VPC to which the KMS instance is attached
VswitchIds.description_zh: KMS实例绑定的VPC中的交换机

ZoneIds.description_en: The zones to which the KMS instance is attached

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
